usage: Archival observational maps for the explorable solar overview and Earth/Moon/Mars mission views, not live telemetry or current weather. Enhanced-color, radar, EUV, source gap fills and unobserved regions are identified per asset. No NASA endorsement. Display rotation and relative body sizes/distances are illustrative, not precision IAU geolocation.
opalAcknowledgement: This work used data acquired from the NASA/ESA HST Space Telescope, associated with OPAL program (PI: Simon, GO13937), and archived by the Space Telescope Science Institute, which is operated by the Association of Universities for Research in Astronomy, Inc., under NASA contract NAS 5-26555. All maps are available at https://doi.org/10.17909/T9G593.

assets.title: Deep Star Maps 2020, celestial coordinates
assets.credit: NASA/Goddard Space Flight Center Scientific Visualization Studio. Gaia DR2: ESA/Gaia/DPAC.
assets.coordinates: ICRF/J2000 right ascension and declination; RA 0 at image centre, increasing left; north at image top.
assets.processing: ImageMagick: linear EXR converted to sRGB JPEG, 4:4:4, quality 92 at 4096x2048; low derivative resized to 1024x512 before sRGB conversion, quality 90. No constellation overlays or invented stars in the images.

assets.title: Packed Blue Marble January 2004 day / Black Marble 2016 night
assets.credit: NASA Earth Observatory / NASA Goddard Space Flight Center. Blue Marble Next Generation: Reto Stockli. Black Marble: NASA/NOAA Suomi NPP VIIRS.
assets.coordinates: Equirectangular longitude/latitude; west -180 to east +180, north at top. Mapped to the core's reduced uniform rotation, not precision IAU geolocation.
assets.processing: Both primary JPEGs resized to 4096x2048. Day RGB and grayscale night luminance packed into RGB and alpha respectively with ImageMagick CopyOpacity, lossless WebP with exact transparent RGB preservation. Alpha represents data, not surface transparency. Warm night-light display tint is illustrative. WebP approved instead of separate JPEG runtime maps to fit 64 MiB.

assets.credit: NASA/Goddard Space Flight Center Scientific Visualization Studio; Blue Marble Next Generation courtesy Reto Stockli (NASA/GSFC) and NASA Earth Observatory.
assets.processing: Existing 1024x512 historical surface retained unchanged; used for Earth in the explorable solar overview and mission context. Not current weather.

assets.credit: USGS Astrogeology Science Center and NASA Viking. USGS public domain, no use constraints.
assets.processing: Existing 1024x512 Viking 1976-1980 color composite retained unchanged; used for Mars in the explorable solar overview and mission views. Red/violet observations with synthesized green; no live weather claim.

assets.title: STEREO+SDO: Around the Sun for 81 Days, frame 0200
assets.credit: NASA/Goddard Space Flight Center Scientific Visualization Studio; Tom Bridgman. STEREO EUVI and SDO AIA.
assets.epoch: April 1–June 20, 2011 source sequence; a single archival visualization frame, not current activity.
assets.coordinates: Global cylindrical-equidistant (equirectangular), 2:1, solar north at top; source orientation preserved.
assets.limitations: 304 Å extreme-ultraviolet observations, displayed in false color, not a visible-light photosphere. Source mosaics combine three spacecraft, smooth overlaps and fill some gaps, particularly near the poles, from the preceding time step. Visualization, not scientific analysis.
assets.processing: NASA 4096x2048 JPEG resized with ImageMagick to 1024x512; metadata stripped, JPEG quality 90, 4:4:4. No invented solar features or color changes.

assets.title: Enhanced Color Mercury Map, PIA17386
assets.credit: NASA/Johns Hopkins University Applied Physics Laboratory/Carnegie Institution of Washington.
assets.epoch: MESSENGER primary-mission MDIS observations; released July 18, 2013.
assets.coordinates: Simple cylindrical, north up, centre 0°N 180°E; left edge 0°E, longitude increases rightward.
assets.limitations: Enhanced-color compositional map over a monochrome base. Principal components and a 430/1000 nm ratio are assigned to RGB; not human-eye color.
assets.processing: NASA 4096x2048 JPEG resized with ImageMagick to 1024x512; metadata stripped, JPEG quality 90, 4:4:4. Source colors and orientation preserved.

assets.title: Venus Magellan radar surface texture
assets.coordinates: Global 2:1 cylindrical texture, north at top; source orientation preserved. Catalog does not specify a precision longitude registration.
assets.limitations: RADAR surface mosaic, not visible clouds or visible-light surface color. NASA catalog explicitly says gaps are filled with global texture; those areas are not independent observations. The atmosphere is omitted to reveal the radar-mapped surface.
assets.processing: NASA 1440x720 JPEG resized with ImageMagick to 1024x512; metadata stripped, JPEG quality 90, 4:4:4. No additional gap filling.

assets.title: Jupiter Voyager planetary map
assets.coordinates: Global 2:1 cylindrical texture, north at top; source orientation preserved. Catalog does not specify a precision longitude registration.
assets.limitations: Historical Voyager atmospheric image composite from the JPL/Caltech map database, not current cloud positions or a solid surface.
assets.processing: NASA 720x360 JPEG resampled with ImageMagick to 1024x512 for consistent bounded globe textures; this does not add observed detail. Metadata stripped, JPEG quality 90, 4:4:4.

assets.title: CGI Moon Kit, 2025 LRO color map
assets.credit: NASA's Scientific Visualization Studio; Ernie Wright. LRO LROC WAC: NASA/GSFC/Arizona State University. Polar albedo: LRO LOLA.
assets.epoch: December 2025 visualization of historical LRO observations.
assets.coordinates: Equirectangular, north up, centre 0° longitude, left -180° and right +180°.
assets.limitations: LROC 643/566/415 nm mosaic with exposure/white-balance adjustments and inpainted small high-latitude dropouts. Outside ±70° latitude the source uses lower-resolution monochrome LOLA laser albedo, not observed RGB. Optimized for aesthetics, not scientific analysis.
assets.processing: NASA 2048x1024 JPEG retained byte-for-byte as moon-lro-2048.jpg; 1024x512 derivative made with ImageMagick, metadata stripped, JPEG quality 90, 4:4:4.

assets.title: Uranus Hubble OPAL Cycle 25, rotation A color map
assets.credit: NASA/ESA Hubble Space Telescope, OPAL (PI: Amy Simon), STScI/AURA; see opalAcknowledgement and opalReferences.
assets.coordinates: Cylindrical longitude/planetographic latitude, north up, left 0°E increasing rightward through 360°.
assets.limitations: Observed HST WFC3/UVIS RGB composite: F657N red, F547M green, F467M blue, contrast-enhanced; not calibrated natural-eye color. Southern polar no-data region remains black; limb/mosaic artifacts remain near coverage boundaries. Black is missing coverage, not a dark physical surface. Not the fictional solid-blue JPL catalog texture.
assets.processing: Source 721x361 TIFF resampled to bounded 1024x512; ImageMagick forced TrueColor to preserve RGB despite source grayscale type metadata, flattened on black, stripped metadata, JPEG quality 90, 4:4:4. No inpainting or fabricated atmospheric features.

assets.title: Neptune Hubble OPAL Cycle 25, rotation B color map
assets.credit: NASA/ESA Hubble Space Telescope, OPAL (PI: Amy Simon), STScI/AURA; see opalAcknowledgement and opalReferences.
assets.coordinates: Cylindrical longitude/planetographic latitude, north up, left 360°W decreasing rightward to 0°W.
assets.limitations: Observed HST WFC3/UVIS RGB composite: F657N red, F547M green, F467M blue, contrast-enhanced; greenish source appearance is not calibrated natural-eye color. Northern polar no-data region remains black; limb/mosaic artifacts remain near coverage boundaries. Black is missing coverage, not a dark physical surface. Not the fictional Don Davis/JPL catalog painting.
assets.processing: Source 721x361 TIFF resampled to bounded 1024x512; ImageMagick TrueColor, source transparency flattened on black, metadata stripped, JPEG quality 90, 4:4:4. No inpainting, recoloring or fabricated atmospheric features.

assets.title: Cassini ISS RGB Saturn Global Color Map Original
assets.label: https://atmos.nmsu.edu/PDS/data/PDS4/co_iss_global-maps/data_derived/Cassini_ISS_RGB_Saturn_global_color_map_original.xml
assets.credit: Li, Liming, Robert West, Xun Jiang and Benjamin Knowles (2023), Cassini ISS Global Maps of Jupiter and Saturn Bundle, NASA Planetary Data System.
assets.coordinates: Equirectangular, planetocentric latitude, north up; left 360°W decreasing rightward to 0°W. Source FITS latitude runs south to north, reversed for the JPEG.
assets.limitations: Observed Cassini ISS RED/GRN/BL1 RGB composite, original version rather than the contrast-enhanced variant. Black equatorial band is missing coverage where rings obstructed observations; polar no-data strips also remain black. Source mosaics use empirical illumination/seam correction. Not current clouds, not a solid surface, not the fictional JPL catalog texture. No invented fill is applied.
assets.processing: Decoded three big-endian float32 FITS planes at byte offset 2880, 3601x1801x3, into interleaved 8-bit RGB using source 0–255 values without rescaling. Reversed south-to-north row order; ImageMagick resized to 1024x512, stripped metadata, JPEG quality 90, 4:4:4. Source zero/no-data pixels remain black.

decodedTextureBudget.format: RGBA8, no mipmaps; ten bounded 1024x512 globe maps shared by the solar explorer. Source resampling does not add observed detail.
decodedTextureBudget.solarRule: Ten 1k globe maps total 20 MiB; the shared sky adds 2 MiB at LOW or 32 MiB at HIGH. Earth/Moon/Mars mission views reuse their body maps, with the 2k lunar derivative available for the higher-quality Moon view. These figures describe decoded solar textures, not total GPU or application memory.
